Area.evidence_source: For the young men in this study, rapid changes in subjective experiences and the loss of self-identity emerged as a recurring theme, linked to their suicide attempts: The overwhelming experience of self-in-crisis ("he fed on that" the personified voice), and feeling "powerless" contributed directly to suicide attempts, as illustrated by Peter: I didn't have a very good image of myself… I didn't think much of myself. At all. And so, he fed on that. Every time I hear him, he's like going on about how worthless I am, how I'm pointless, how I'm pathetic and it just doesn't, doesn't feel good (Peter).
